newsitem.title: INDIA: India's NTPC signs power purchase pact with state.
newsitem.headline: India's NTPC signs power purchase pact with state.

text.p: India's state-owned National Thermal Power Corporation (NTPC) said on Wednesday that it had signed a power purchase agreement with the southern state of Andhra Pradesh for a proposed new plant.

The agreement for the 1,000-megawatt Simbhatri thermal power project, to be established in the coastal city of Visakhapatnam, was signed on Wednesday after prolonged discussions with the state government, NTPC said in a statement.
The state-run Andhra Pradesh State Electricity Board (APSEB) will purchase electricity generated by the plant.
"The entire power generated at this project is envisaged to be commissioned in 56 months from the date of government approval," the statement added.
The agreement paves the way for the project's approval by the federal cabinet, it said.
